newsitem.title: LEBANON: MEA stewards suspend Sunday strike over pay.
newsitem.headline: MEA stewards suspend Sunday strike over pay.

text.p: Middle East Airlines (MEA) stewards suspended a planned seven-hour strike on Sunday over pay demands, the MEA stewards union said in a statement published on Saturday.

It said the union decided to cancel Sunday's strike after Labour Minister Assad Hardan asked for a two-week period for MEA management to study their demands and company chairman Khaled Salam promised to decide on them within that period.
"The strike has been suspended provided that the Lebanese stewards' demands be decided on within a maximum period of two weeks," the statement said.

The union said on Friday that it had decided to stage the strike as the MEA management failed to keep its promises to meet salary demands by the company employees, which include the adoption of a new payscale for the company's 330 stewards.
The strike would have delayed nine MEA scheduled flights out of Beirut including flights to London, Rome, Frankfurt and Paris.
